name: South Java Current
scope: Partial Java-Bali study reach at OSW-selected105E/115E truncations. Offshore vertices are drawing choices, not observed axis points. Excludes Sumatra, Lombok recirculation, Savu-Ombai extension and the SJCU.
layer: Surface-feature geographic context only. The source model defines SJCC above150m; no fixed-depth axis or physical current thickness is assigned to this drawing.
time_convention: No dated route. Model1990-2003 and observational2004-2006 contexts remain separate; neither is assigned as the drawing observation interval.
source_locator: Iskandar2006 paragraphs10-14 and Figure3 caption for study meridians; Sprintall2010 Figure1 and caption on PDF3 for regional system geography.
source_citation: Iskandar et al.2006, DOI10.1029/2006JC003486; Sprintall et al.2010, DOI10.1016/j.dynatmoce.2010.02.006.
source_license: Source facts and geography only; no source figures redistributed and no open reuse license inferred.
coordinate_selection: All coordinates selected by OSW.105E and115E are study-meridian truncations, not physical endpoints. No current contour, streamline or observed core has been digitized.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Editorial bend sensitivity only; not a width edge or a season.
